_comment: Copy to accounts.json (gitignored) and fill in. Use password_env to pull secrets from the environment instead of storing them here. Only smoke_atm_roundtrip is implemented so far (P3 rolls out the rest), so every account below runs it -- copying this file as-is is meant to work out of the box. Swap in patient_calls_dip / aggressive_puts_reload / patient_puts_dip / cheap_atm_calls / cheap_atm_puts for an account only once that strategy is registered; the runner validates strategy_id at startup and refuses to start rather than crashing mid-run on an unregistered one.
